prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: game sprite sheet for the Windows RTS Cultures / 8th Wonder of the World. The input is a style/costume reference, NOT a sheet to copy.
Create ONE consistent saracen longsword unit as an EXACT 8-column x 8-row sprite sheet, 64 complete sprites, truly transparent background, square canvas. Late-1990s tiny pre-rendered RTS pixel sprite look, compact stocky human proportions, fixed orthographic isometric camera looking down around 35 degrees, crisp restrained highlights, readable at 40-pixel character height.
Costume and identity: Saracen soldier from the reference: dark brown skin, grey wrapped steel helmet with short central metal finial (no horns), teal upper tunic, ochre trousers, brown boots and belt, gold/brass wrist guards; long straight steel sword in right hand, left hand free.
Weapon: a LONGSWORD: clearly longer than a short sword, long straight double-edged steel blade, simple crossguard and brown grip. No curved saber, no bow, no giant fantasy sword. Keep exactly the same weapon, costume, hands and body scale in all frames.
GRID AND PADDING ARE CRITICAL: 8 x 8 equal cells. Each sprite including sword, shield and feet MUST fit inside the central 65% of its cell with transparent padding on ALL FOUR sides. Nobody touches cell boundaries or image edges. Uniform foot anchor near 78% cell height, centered character, no shadows, no text, no grid lines, no scenery. Prefer smaller figures and more empty space to clipped swords or boots.
Columns, identical for every row: south/front; southwest/front-left; west/left profile; northwest/back-left; north/back; northeast/back-right; east/right profile; southeast/front-right. Fixed camera, turn only the character. Show genuinely distinct facing orientations including back views.
Rows: 1 idle holding longsword lowered; 2 walk left foot forward; 3 walking passing pose; 4 walk right foot forward; 5 opposite walking passing pose; 6 attack wind-up raising longsword; 7 sword strike/contact aimed along the column facing direction; 8 recovery with sword lowered. Distinct readable attack phases, weapon hand stays consistent.
Maintain one character identity and stable proportions across all 64 frames. Match the reference game's modest visual detail, avoid glossy modern fantasy renders. Real alpha transparency, no painted checkerboard or baked background.
reference: Locally extracted original saracen soldier sprites; not included in the repository
